description: Tracks the state of an active or recently concluded combat encounter. When combat ends, set active to false and preserve the final state until the next scene.

fields.active: boolean — true while combat is ongoing, false once all enemies are defeated, fled, or the encounter is resolved
fields.round: integer — current combat round, starts at 1, increments after all participants have acted
fields.current_turn: string or null — name of the combatant whose turn it currently is
fields.turn_order: array of strings — participant names sorted by initiative from highest to lowest
fields.participants: array of objects — one entry per combatant: { name, type (player|npc), actor_sheet_id (required for npc rows), hp, max_hp, conditions (array of strings), position (string or null) }
fields.terrain_notes: string or null — notable terrain features affecting combat (difficult terrain, cover, elevation, hazards)
fields.battlefield_ref: object or null — while active==true, { id, version, topology } pointing at the live adventure_battlefields row; cleared when combat ends
fields.last_battlefield_ref: object or null — after combat ends, points at archived battlefield row for recap until scene reset
fields.action_economy: object or null — turn pool for the current actor: round, holder, standard_available, move_available, swift_available, full_round_claimed (BETA shape)

notes: When combat_initialization is present in mutations, write it verbatim without modification.
When combat_state_advancement is present in mutations, merge/write it verbatim into combat_context without modification (same rule as combat_initialization).
HP values must always come from canonical_hp when provided — never calculate or estimate.
When combat is active, preserve every NPC participant's actor_sheet_id exactly.
Set active to false when the outcome describes all enemies defeated, fled, or surrendered.
Do not clear this context immediately after combat ends — preserve the post-combat state for scene continuity.
